summary: Master Metaverse and Virtual Reality in marketing. Learn spatial computing, V-commerce, and VR analytics to drive immersive engagement. Enroll today.
lede: Metaverse marketing training helps experienced marketing professionals and digital architects plan and assess immersive brand campaigns. It develops practical approaches to measuring spatial engagement, designing 360-degree narratives, and planning augmented-reality product journeys and virtual commerce. The syllabus also covers avatar communities, digital assets, virtual events, and privacy and governance considerations, supporting campaign planning from concept through evaluation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-to-advanced program is designed for seasoned marketing professionals and digital architects who are responsible for the next generation of brand engagement.
prerequisites: Participants should have 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, brand management, or e-commerce. Familiarity with basic Web3 concepts (NFTs, Blockchain) and experience managing digital creative agencies are highly recommended. No coding knowledge is required, but an analytical mindset and experience with data-driven marketing platforms are essential.
